experiment_template.research_question: Can an explicit outcome taxonomy preserve failures and complete the frozen denominator?
stop_conditions: Every Round 20 identity runs at most once.
No prior-round identity is resumed or rerun.
No task, state, prompt, order, context/model cap, total-token cap, threshold or scorer change.
Only the enumerated failure taxonomy and durable local-failure recording may change.

records.falsifier: An accepted local outcome has unknown usage or shared corruption, a local outcome is lost after a later stop, a shared integrity failure continues, or the successor still censors an independent cell on an enumerated fully accounted branch-local outcome.
records.mechanism: Classify only enumerated terminal branch outcomes whose dispatched model receipts all have known input and output usage. A successful HTTP model response that fails bounded response-shape validation remains a failed local outcome; source, prefix, ancestry, export, score, unknown-usage and unenumerated failures remain global. Persist each accepted local failure before dispatching the next cell.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A closed taxonomy of fully accounted branch-local transport and model-output outcomes, combined with immediate durable failure receipts, will let the frozen GLM-5.3-flash 8K sequence reach its full denominator without weakening shared integrity stops.

records.claim: Round 20 accounted all 56 frozen cells and reached sequence completion with zero unknown model usage. No local failure occurred live, so the exact Round 19 replay and offline controls support the broadened classifier while live continuation remains unexposed. Separately, H25 crossed scheduled span and file thresholds with fewer state tokens but missed valid-completion and exact-presentation gates.
limitations: Native evidence selection is not repair correctness or semantic retention.
One task terminated before treatment exposure.
Only 18/24 pairs had scores in both arms.
The local continuation path was not naturally exposed live.

records.next_action: Preserve Round 20. Keep the typed local outcome and durable ledger implementation. Add one common, bounded, schema-complete second terminal correction inside the unchanged 96K model-token cap, prove its stop/accounting/tool-forbiddance rules, then freeze Round 21 with semantic variables unchanged.
